name: Invoice Desk
office_task: When a job is marked complete, put its draft invoice in Xero at our own prices, park what it cannot price, and send only once a named person or their rule releases it.
systems_of_record: the job system that issues the job_id (ServiceM8, Simpro, or a job sheet)

emits.write: One draft invoice in Xero per completed job, keyed to the job id (reference job:<id>, and the stage under a building contract), every line a job line priced from the Xero Items read at draft time, carrying the book edition and any signed variation acceptance.
emits.readback: The invoice is read back from the ledger by the job id (Xero GET /api.xro/2.0/Invoices/{InvoiceID}) and must return the same invoice id, its external id and the job id. No id back is not a write: it raises invoice.write_failed and the run stops.

emits.write: The release on the invoice record, naming the person who closed the awaiting-release exception or the rule (with its threshold) that person set, then the send from the ledger. Nothing parked is ever sent.
emits.readback: The invoice read back by its id shows status sent, the sent time, and released_by or released_by_rule, with the release before the send.

emits.write: A parked or waiting invoice as an exception on the job: the reason from the standard's fixed list (not_in_pricebook, unsigned_variation, no_stage, write_failed) or awaiting_release, the job id, the invoice id, the unpriced codes with no rate, and exception_owner set to the person the business named for invoices.
emits.readback: The exception desk returns the exception against the job id, and reading it back returns the job_id, invoice_id, reason and exception_owner; the next hop reads it there and stops.

port_of.original_name: Create and approve Xero invoices from Pipedrive Closed Won deals with Slack
